segments.line: Here's where you are. Rome, the year one thirteen. The
emperor Trajan rules everything from the Atlantic to the Red Sea.
And Rome is the biggest city on Earth, with maybe a million people. That's real.
Here's what you've got. One ordinary car. A full tank, enough for about six hundred kilometers. Two phones with no signal. A charger. Half a bag of chips. And Mo's playlist.
The car works perfectly. The engine, the lights, the horn, the speakers.
Nothing in this world can stop it.
nearest gas station is about eighteen hundred years away.
Every drop of fuel you burn is gone forever.
And one more thing. As far as you know,
yours is the only engine on the planet. The only one.
